Overview

Keelung is a city in Keelung with a population of 367,000. A major port city in northern Taiwan, known for its harbor, night market, and as a gateway to the northeast coast. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
